== Notes ==
* Because its snare duration does not scale and can affect nearby foes, Earthen Shackles has good synergy with spells that deal [[damage over time]] since it prevents foes from moving out of the area of those spells. 

== Trivia ==
* The [[functionality]] of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[Earthen Shackles/Skill history|skill history]] for details.
